question: Which of the following amendments made the Fundamental Duty of parents to provide education to their children between the age of 6 and 14 years?
solution:
The correct answer is **__86th Amendment Act, 2002__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The 86th Amendment Act** was passed in **2002** and added **Article 21-A** to the Indian Constitution, making** free and compulsory education **for children between the ages of** 6 and 14** a **fundamental right**.
 
• The amendment aimed to provide **equal opportunities** for all children to access **quality education**, regardless of their **socio-economic background**.
